children: Profusa demonstrated compliance with Nasdaq bid-price and equity listing rules and remains subject to a one-year mandatory Panel Monitor.
Nasdaq confirmed Profusa met Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) (Bid Price) and 5550(b)(1) (Equity).
Profusa will be subject to a one-year Mandatory Panel Monitor under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5815(d)(4)(B).
If Profusa falls out of compliance during the Monitoring Period, Nasdaq will issue a prompt Staff Delisting Determination.
Profusa will not be allowed to submit a compliance plan or receive additional cure time for recurring equity deficiencies during the Monitoring Period, though it may appeal.
The company intends to monitor ongoing compliance with Nasdaq continued listing requirements.
